title: An open immersion of schemes is a monomorphism
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $j$ is a monomorphism in the category of schemes: for any scheme $T$ and morphisms $a,b:T\to U$ with $j\circ a=j\circ b$ one has $a=b$.
